How good is Planetside 2 on Playstation 4?

I've played a lot of Planetside 2 on PC; I haven't played The PS4 version so I can't say much about that, although besides the control scheme and platform it is largely the same.

Planetside 2 has a lot of awesome strengths, but then some real flaws. Its biggest strength is the overall concept, there are so few MMOFPS games out there, when it is such an awesome concept that turns simple little fights of normal FPSs into massive battles over territories. When you get in a good battle, it is truly epic.

The biggest flaw with the game is it tends to feel a bit lackluster, as there isn't much to keep you playing besides the desire for combat and the desire to grind points to buy more weapons. It also has some notable flaws with the metagame, certain details of the game can sometimes encourage mindless zerging that isn't fun for anyone.

Ultimately it is a decent game, and so long as my internet isn't being crappy it tends to be my go-to FPS when I feel the desire to shoot stuff. The game strongly encourages squad-based combat, but even just going in alone and following the crowd can be fun.

For more information I know www.reddit.com/r/Planetside is one of the main community resources for the game, the devs have a presence there (fair warning, people there tend to be very critical of the game, but it comes from a place of love for it and desire to improve it whereever possible)

See my reply in the last post you made about this: https://voat.co/v/gaming/comments/212150

Also, the game is free. Why not just try it out?

I don't play it, but my boyfriend literally just was playing it for about 4 hours straight. I'll ask him for you.

Boyfriend's report: "pretty decent, but be wary of what server you choose. Battles are large, but not as big as PC. Many areas on the map are left empty, leading to a desolate experience if you're not on the front line."

Most of the servers have low populations and the factions aren't very balanced, so if you play late at night you may find yourself just wandering around taking bases with little or no resistance. It also seems like the game suffers from pop-ups now and again (Last night an enemy tank popped-up 20 feet away from my squad and murdered us). The game still has some stability issues to work out.

I hope the game gets polished a bit more, because the giant battles are a blast to participate in.
